matched_reference.reason: same-material independent full-DtN reference and mesh convergence were not run

assembly_temporary_cache_bytes_local.scope: assembly-time peak components; raw/oriented arrays are released after return

periodic_faces.meaning: actual periodic geometry/tag evidence; not an MPC residual test

mesh_evidence.scope: actual target mesh/material/spaces only; not a solver or convergence result

field_export.exact_reference_note: Stage 4 grating has no analytic exact solution; E_b is the layered background field, so E_exact is not written.

port_metrics.dtn_port_modal_amplitude_convention: auxiliary unknown a_j is the total-field port projection. top outgoing amplitude = a_j - incident_projection_j; bottom outgoing amplitude = a_j. Power uses boundary-plane outgoing amplitude after applying boundary_phase.
port_metrics.dtn_port_modal_reference: top=physical_z_max; bottom=physical_z_min; bottom lossy power uses boundary-plane phase attenuation
port_metrics.dtn_port_power_metric_note: Stage-4 dtn_port R/T is computed directly from auxiliary outgoing modal amplitudes on the finite top and bottom port faces. Selected modes with positive outward real-Poynting flux contribute even when a below-critical lossy mode retains propagating=false; lossless evanescent modes carry zero modal power.

volume_metrics.epsilon_definition: epsilon_r = n^2; the absorption integrand uses Im(epsilon_r), not Im(n)
volume_metrics.normalization_note: A_volume uses the current Stage-4 code-unit normalization: P_abs = integral 0.5*k0*Im(epsilon_r)*|E_total|^2 dV over physical material cells, divided by incident_power_code_units. PML cells and air cells are deliberately excluded from material volume absorption. The k0 factor follows from H_code=curl(E)/(i*k0*mu_r) and the corresponding Poynting balance.

curl_samples.scope: DG-interpolated curl samples from exported H; native full FE coefficients saved separately

power_groups.normalization: same incident power as all 572 original port rows

y_diagnostics.scope: sampled complex fields at fixed (x,z); no phase fitting
